changelog: Dev build v835. Fixes a host crash in the CSM player settings screen: a ListPreference summary is used as a String.format template, so an option label containing a literal percent ('Light (15%)', 'Medium (30%)', 'Strong (45%)' for Controls Dim Level) threw UnknownFormatConversionException: Conversion = ')' while the settings list rendered or prefetched. Option labels are now escaped before being used as the summary template and still render unchanged. Also carries the v834 self-test PACKAGED_ABI probe-classloader fix and the active self-test campaign. This dev build aggregates all current unpublished source in the shared CSM tree and is not an isolated patch.
message: Dev build v835 - fix player settings ListPreference summary crash
